title: Correcting Yourself
goal: Correct yourself with mejor dicho and say what something is rather than what it is not with más bien.

items: I can correct myself with mejor dicho.
I can say what something is rather than what it is not, with más bien.
I can use the new words for slips of the tongue and corrections.
